answer_1.quote: We propose SceneGenAgent, an LLM-based coding agent capable of generating industrial scenes from descriptions, analyzing and improving layout for precise generation
answer_1.outputs: C# code for generating industrial 3D scenes using Tecnomatix APIs

answer_2.quote: We adopt the pass@k metric , a commonly used metric for coding performance that measures the ratio of programming problems where at least one out of k generated code samples qualifies.

answer_4.quote: Our evaluation team consists of 3 members with expertise in industrial scenes and proficiency in the Process Simulate software.
answer_4.guideline: carefully comparing each scene against its description
